// tests/dateutil_vectors_tests.nv — three hundred rules drawn at random
// and expanded by python-dateutil's `rrule`, as a differential oracle.
//
// Generated by tools/dateutil_vectors.py with a fixed seed.  Do not edit
// the table: run the tool.  Each row is a `DTSTART`, a rule, and the
// first occurrences dateutil answers for it, up to twelve and up to a
// hundred years on.  The tool keeps only the rules both libraries give
// one meaning: every part allowed under its frequency, and a `DTSTART`
// the rule itself produces.

use std.test
use std.str
use std.list
use civil
use rruleerror
use rruleiter
use rruleparse
use rruleset
